e3d.hint.mirror: Click a grid line or a wall as the axis, or two points on the work plane · Alt — free axis · Esc exits
e3d.hint.array: Click the base point, then move or type: value, or count and value (6 2.5; 4;300 when the step has three digits, since 4 300 reads as 4300) · Enter applies · Esc exits
e3d.err.array_max: An array takes at most 200 placements.
x3d.axis.wall_selected: The selected wall cannot be the mirror axis. Pick another wall or a grid line, or click two points.
x3d.bad_angle: Not an angle: enter degrees, for example 90
x3d.no.panel: A panel belongs to its curtain wall: select the wall
x3d.need_axis: Pick the mirror axis: a grid line, a wall, or two points
x3d.need_input: Move the cursor or type a value to set the array
edit3d.del.nothing: the element is already gone or cannot be deleted
edit3d.del.no_family: this category has no delete yet
edit3d.paste.offset: {n} copies placed one grid step aside, so they do not cover the originals
